package postgres

import (
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
	"testing"
)

func TestStoredAssignmentCorrelationAndCompletionAreImmutable(t *testing.T) {
	current := domain.TaskInstance{LearningPathItemID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", RequirementID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"}
	raw, err := marshalInstance(current)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	restored, err := unmarshalInstance(raw)
	if err != nil || restored.LearningPathItemID != current.LearningPathItemID || restored.RequirementID != current.RequirementID {
		t.Fatalf("lost durable correlation: %+v %v", restored, err)
	}
	changed := current
	changed.RequirementID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003"
	if validateInstanceUpdate(current, changed) == nil || sameCompletionBinding(current, changed) {
		t.Fatal("changed assignment accepted")
	}
	submission := domain.Submission{}
	if !evidenceIdentityMismatch([]byte(`{}`), current, submission) {
		t.Fatal("omitted correlation accepted")
	}
	if evidenceIdentityMismatch([]byte(`{"learning_path_item_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","requirement_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"}`), current, submission) {
		t.Fatal("exact correlation rejected")
	}
	legacy, err := unmarshalInstance([]byte(`{"instance":{}}`))
	if err != nil || legacy.LearningPathItemID != "" || legacy.RequirementID != "" {
		t.Fatal("legacy stored instance incompatible")
	}
}

func TestPersistenceAcceptsCheckpointedProgress(t *testing.T) {
	instance := domain.TaskInstance{Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "first", Required: true, Status: "CHECKPOINTED"}, {ID: "next", Required: true, Status: "AVAILABLE"}}, Progress: domain.Progress{PassedSteps: 1, TotalSteps: 2, Percentage: 50}}
	if !validProgressProjection(instance) {
		t.Fatal("checkpointed progress rejected by persistence")
	}
	instance.Progress.PassedSteps = 2
	instance.Progress.Percentage = 100
	if validProgressProjection(instance) {
		t.Fatal("available step counted as completed")
	}
}

func TestOnlyTerminalSubmissionCanBeReplaced(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []domain.SubmissionStatus{domain.SubmissionPassed, domain.SubmissionFailed, domain.SubmissionChangesRequested} {
		if !terminalSubmissionAllowsNext(status) {
			t.Fatalf("terminal %s cannot retry", status)
		}
	}
	for _, status := range []domain.SubmissionStatus{domain.SubmissionValidating, domain.SubmissionReviewRequired, ""} {
		if terminalSubmissionAllowsNext(status) {
			t.Fatalf("active %s can be replaced", status)
		}
	}
}
